data.gender_notes: Nusaiybah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nasaihah' which means 'a light, guidance or a source of good.' This name is often associated with the guidance and light that one receives from the divine, particularly during times of spiritual or personal struggle. The name Nusaiybah carries the meaning “A light in the darkness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusaiybah usually hope their child will grow to embody a light in the darkness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: In the context of Islamic history, the name Nusaiybah is specifically linked to Umm Nusaym bint Kab al-Anbariya, a well-known companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). She was known for her extraordinary hospitality and was the first woman to offer refuge to the Prophet and his companions when they were driven out of Mecca during the Hijrah (migration) to Medina. Nusaybah's act of generosity and hospitality set an example for future generations, reflecting the importance of offering help and shelter to those in need in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nusaiybah holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nasaihah,' meaning 'a light or guidance.' In Islamic tradition, the name is often associated with the spiritual guidance and light that one receives from the divine. This could be during times of personal struggle, spiritual growth, or seeking answers to life's questions. The name is also a reminder of the importance of following the right path and seeking guidance from Allah (SWT).
